lines.text: Buying a ten million dollar mansion is the cheap part.
Los Angeles. Infinity pool, canyon views, full-time staff.
Property tax, about one point two percent: a hundred twenty grand a year.
Insuring the house and everything in it: about seventy-two grand.
Upkeep, using the one percent rule: another hundred grand.
A house manager, a private chef and a housekeeper: two hundred ninety grand, at the low end.
Before you flip a light switch: almost six hundred grand a year. Forty-eight thousand a month.
